local_compute_setting: ordinary PC for orchestration, execution, scoring, and evidence storage; no local GPU required
private_scorer_policy: one final-only call per condition; no private feedback returned to the model
success_rule: hard constraints pass and within-run hidden-case pass rate is at least 0.95
inference_rule: two-sided run-level Clopper-Pearson interval with alpha=0.02; minimum prevalence threshold 0.8
scope_note: This minimal public object contains only protocol metadata and cryptographic digests. Source, task content, manuscript text, and raw research artifacts remain local.
